newsitem.title: USA: WMX files $1 bln shelf for debt securities.
newsitem.headline: WMX files $1 bln shelf for debt securities.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc. filed a shelf offering Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1 billion in Series E medium-term notes.
The offering brings the total to $1.25 billion when added with previously registered debt, the Oak Brook, Ill., company said in the filing.
Underwriters for the shelf offering are Merrill Lynch & Co and Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to retire outstanding debt and for general corporate purposes.
